heard: How many views can YouTube actually count? It's not that computers can't count that high. The counter has a fixed number of switches. YouTube stored every view count in 32 bits, 32 switches, each on or off. Each switch you add doubles the count. Ten switches reach 1 ,023, 20 reach a million. But the first switch is saved for the minus sign. That leaves 31. 31 switches top out at 2 ,147 ,483 ,000, 647. Now add one more view. Every switch flips, even the sign. Now it reads minus 2 billion. In 2014, Gangnam Style passed that line. So YouTube moved the counter to 64 bits. That counts to 9 .2 quintillion. Enough for everyone on Earth to watch it a billion times. Subscribe if you thought the internet could count forever.
